verses.en: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father’s bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.
verses.pt: Quanto aos filhos de Rúben, primogênito de Israel (porque ele era o primogênito, mas como profanou a cama de de seu pai, seu direito de primogenitura foi dado aos filhos de José, filho de Israel; e não foi contado por primogênito.
verses.en_web: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn; but, because he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Reuben, the oldest son of Israel, (for he was the oldest son, but, because he made his father's bride-bed unclean, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph, the son of Israel; but he is not to be given the place of the oldest.

verses.en: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Joseph’s:)
verses.pt: Pois Judá foi o mais poderoso sobre seus irmãos, e o líder veio dele; mas o direito de primogenitura pertenceu a José).
verses.en_web: For Judah prevailed above his brothers, and from him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s)—
verses.en_bbe: Though Judah became stronger than his brothers, and from him came the ruler, the birthright was Joseph's:)

verses.en: The sons, I say, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Rúben, primogênito de Israel, foram, pois: Enoque, Palu, Hezrom e Carmi.
verses.en_web: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Reuben, the oldest son of Israel: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi.

verses.en: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
verses.pt: Os filhos de Joel foram: seu filho Semaías, seu filho Gogue, seu filho Simei;
verses.en_web: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

verses.en: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,
verses.pt: Seu filho Mica, seu filho Reaías, seu filho Baal;
verses.en_web: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
verses.en_bbe: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

verses.en: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.
verses.pt: Seu filho Beera, o qual foi transportado por Tiglate-Pilneser, rei dos Assírios. Este era um líder dos Rubenitas.
verses.en_web: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.
verses.en_bbe: Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-pileser, king of Assyria, took away as a prisoner: he was chief of the Reubenites.

verses.en: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
verses.pt: E seus irmãos por suas famílias, quando foram registrados em suas descendências, tinham por líderes a Jeiel, Zacarias.
verses.en_web: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
verses.en_bbe: And his brothers by their families, when the list of their generations was made up: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

verses.en: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baal-meon:
verses.pt: E Belá, filho de Azaz, filho de Sema, filho de Joel. Eles habitaram em Aroer até Nebo e Baal-Meom.
verses.en_web: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;
verses.en_bbe: And Bela, the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who was living in Aroer, as far as Nebo and Baal-meon;

verses.en: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
verses.pt: Habitaram também desde o oriente até a entrada do deserto desde o rio Eufrates; porque seu gado tinha se multiplicado na terra de Gileade.
verses.en_web: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
verses.en_bbe: And to the east his limits went as far as the starting point of the waste land, ending at the river Euphrates, because their cattle were increased in number in the land of Gilead.

verses.en: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead.
verses.pt: E nos dias de Saul fizeram guerra contra os hagarenos, que caíram em suas mãos; e eles habitaram em suas tendas sobre toda a região oriental de Gileade.
verses.en_web: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.
verses.en_bbe: And in the days of Saul they made war on the Hagarites, and overcame them; and they put up their tents through all the land east of Gilead.

verses.en: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salchah:
verses.pt: E os filhos de Gade habitaram na vizinhança deles na terra de Basã até Salca.
verses.en_web: The sons of Gad lived over against them, in the land of Bashan to Salecah:
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Gad were living opposite to them, in the land of Bashan as far as Salecah:

verses.en: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
verses.pt: E Joel foi o líder em Basã, o segundo Safã, em seguida Janai, e Safate.
verses.en_web: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
verses.en_bbe: Joel the chief, and Shapham the second, and Janai and Shaphat in Bashan;

verses.en: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.
verses.pt: E seus irmãos, segundo as famílias de seus pais, foram sete: Micael, Mesulão, Sebá, Jorai, Jacã, Zia, e Héber.
verses.en_web: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.
verses.en_bbe: And their brothers, the men of their family: Michael and Meshullam and Sheba and Jorai and Jacan and Zia and Eber, seven of them.

verses.en: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
verses.pt: Estes foram os filhos de Abiail filho de Huri, filho de Jaroa, filho de Gileade, filho de Micael, filho de Jesisai, filho de Jado, filho de Buz.
verses.en_web: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
verses.en_bbe: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

verses.en: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.
verses.pt: Aí, filho de Abdiel, filho de Guni, foi chefe da casa de seus pais.
verses.en_web: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.
verses.en_bbe: Ahi, the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, head of their families.

verses.en: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.
verses.pt: Eles habitaram em Gileade, em Basã, e em suas aldeias, e em todos os campos de Sarom até os seus extremos.
verses.en_web: They lived in Gilead in Bashan, and in its towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, as far as their borders.
verses.en_bbe: And they were living in Gilead in Bashan, in its small towns and in all the grass-land of Sirion as far as its limits.

verses.en: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.pt: Todos estes foram contados segundo suas genealogias nos dias de Jotão, rei de Judá, e no dias de Jeroboão, rei de Israel.
verses.en_web: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: All these were listed under the names of their families, in the time of Jotham, king of Judah, and in the time of Jeroboam, king of Israel.

verses.en: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Rúben, e de Gade, e da meia tribo de Manassés, homens guerreiros, homens que traziam escudo e espada, que entesavam arco, e habilidosos em guerra, havia quarenta e quatro mil setecentos e sessenta capazes de ir para a batalha.
verses.en_web: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty, that were able to go out to war.
verses.en_bbe: There were forty-four thousand, seven hundred and sixty of the sons of Reuben and of the Gadites and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, all strong men, expert in the use of the body-cover, the sword, and the bow, and in the art of war, all able to take up arms.

verses.en: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.
verses.pt: E fizeram guerra contra os Hagarenos, como também a Jetur, Nafis, e Nodabe.
verses.en_web: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.
verses.en_bbe: And they went to war against the Hagarites, with Jetur and Naphish and Nodab.

verses.en: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.
verses.pt: E foram ajudados contra ele; assim os hagarenos, e todos quantos estavam com eles, foram enregues em suas mãos, porque clamaram a Deus na batalha, e ele lhes atendeu, pois confiaram nele.
verses.en_web: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he answered them, because they put their trust in him.
verses.en_bbe: And they were helped against them, so that the Hagarites, and those with them, were given into their power. For they sent up prayers to God in the fight, and he gave ear to them, because they put their faith in him.

verses.en: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.
verses.pt: E tomaram seu gado, cinquenta mil de seus camelos, duzentas e cinquenta mil ovelhas, dois mil asnos, e cem mil pessoas.
verses.en_web: They took away their livestock; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men one hundred thousand.
verses.en_bbe: And they took away their cattle: fifty thousand camels, two hundred and fifty thousand sheep, and two thousand asses, and a hundred thousand men.

verses.en: For there fell down many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.
verses.pt: E muitos caíram mortos, porque a guerra era de Deus; e habitaram em seus lugares até o cativeiro.
verses.en_web: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.
verses.en_bbe: And a very great number went to their death, because the war was God's purpose. And they went on living in their place till they were taken away as prisoners.

verses.en: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baal-hermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.
verses.pt: E os filhos da meia tribo de Manassés habitaram naquela terra, e eles se multiplicaram desde Basã até Baal-Hermom, e Senir e o monte de Hermom.
verses.en_web: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land: they increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
verses.en_bbe: And the men of the half-tribe of Manasseh were living in the land: and their numbers were increased till all the land from Bashan to Baal-hermon and Senir and the mountain Hermon was theirs.

verses.en: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.
verses.pt: E estes foram os cabeças das casas de seus pais: Efer, Isi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremias, Hodavias, e Jadiel, homens valentes e fortes, homens renomados, e cabeças das casas de seus pais.
verses.en_web: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: even Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.
verses.en_bbe: And these were the heads of their families: Epher and Ishi and Eliel and Azriel and Jeremiah and Hodaviah and Jahdiel, men of war, of great name, heads of families.

verses.en: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
verses.pt: Porém eles transgrediram contra o Deus de seus pais, e se prostituíram seguindo os deuses dos povos da terra, aos quais o SENHOR havia destruído de diante deles.
verses.en_web: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
verses.en_bbe: And they did evil against the God of their fathers, worshipping the gods of the people of the land, whom God had put to destruction before them.

verses.en: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.
verses.pt: Por isso o Deus de Israel despertou ao espírito de Pul, rei da Assíria, e ao espírito de Tiglate-Pilneser, rei da Assíria, o qual levou presos os rubenitas, os gaditas e à meia tribo de Manassés, e os trouxe até Hala, Habor, Hara, e ao rio Gozã, até hoje.
verses.en_web: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.
verses.en_bbe: And the God of Israel put an impulse into the heart of Pul, king of Assyria, and of Tiglath-pileser, king of Assyria, who took them away as prisoners, all the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, to Halah and Habor and Hara and to the river of Gozan, to this day.
